data.title: Tropical Depression Fay (AT1), advisory 28/0846Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: FAY PERSISTS IN THE CENTRAL ATLANTIC. As of 9:00 AM GMT Mon Sep 28 the center of Fay was located near 27.9, -44.1 with movement SSW at 7 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1012 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 35 mph.

data.title: Hurricane Polo (EP2), advisory 28/0852Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: LIFE-THREATENING WINDS AND FLASH FLOODS EXPECTED OVER PORTIONS OF BAJA CALIFORNIA SUR AND SONORA TODAY AND TUESDAY. ...CONDITIONS EXPECTED TO BEGIN DETERIORATING THIS MORNING IN BAJA CALIFORNIA SUR... As of 2:00 AM MST Mon Sep 28 the center of Polo was located near 23.6, -113.8 with movement NNE at 10 mph. The minimum central pressure was 958 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 115 mph.

data.title: Tropical Storm Rachel (EP3), advisory 28/1125Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: RACHEL EXPECTED TO BECOME A HURRICANE LATER THIS WEEK. As of 6:00 AM CST Mon Sep 28 the center of Rachel was located near 13.4, -100.9 with movement WNW at 8 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1001 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 45 mph.
